aliasPropertyInModelsOrContent.result: No explicit sling:alias (or equivalent page alias property) found in models/*.json, blocks/*/_*.json, or JS sources.
aliasPropertyInModelsOrContent.note: Keep sling:alias as expected AEM property pending content-level confirmation in author repository.

componentUrlBehavior.result: EDS components mostly consume/emit path values. Conversion helper normalizes between /content/... and public /{locale}/... paths without explicit alias resolution.

helixQueryAliasSupport.result: helix-query.yaml indexes path, title, description, etc., but does not index sling:alias or alias field explicitly.

queryIndexPathSemantics.result: Runtime query-index.json and articles-index.json return only path; no separate alias field observed.
queryIndexPathSemantics.interpretation: Index currently exposes public URL path segment, but cannot prove from index alone whether segment came from node name or sling:alias.

slugBuildersInHelpers.result: There are helpers that build links from slug-like values manually when full path is unavailable.
evidence: scripts/iberostar/page-links.js#appendPageSegment builds child path with encoded segment

recommendation.result: Keep node names stable (do_not_translate). Use page alias for localized public URLs when available. Govern alias as controlled review field. For tags, keep technical name/ID untranslated and translate only visible title/label.
